title: Penguin Solutions Sets Conference Call for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Results
summary: Penguin Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company that designs, builds, and manages next-generation AI data center infrastructure worldwide, will host a conference call on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Daylight Time (PDT) / 4:30 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) to discuss its financial results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026, which ended August 28, 2026. The call will be available to the public as a live, audio-only webcast at ir.penguinsolutions.com . Prior to the call, the earnings press release and investor presentation will be posted at the same location. A replay of the webcast will be available on the IR Events page for one year. body_markdown:
Penguin Solutions is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.


With deep design expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, our Full-Stack AI Factory Platform combines differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate deployment, optimize token economics, and maximize the return on their AI investments.
